page.title: Let's describe your need before choosing a solution.
page.intro: Share your context, your users, and your goals so Infotechs Solutions can review your request. This step doesn't replace scoping or a tailored proposal.
page.usageTitle: When a need is worth clarifying.
page.usageText: Use this form to send a first request related to a website, an automation, a web application, or an audit and scoping need.
page.prepTitle: Prepare what helps us understand the need.
prepItems: The context and the users involved
The goal to reach or the problem to solve
The tools, constraints, and deadlines already known
page.channelNote: The form remains the recommended channel for a detailed request.

nextSteps.title: Reviewing the need
nextSteps.text: Context, users, and constraints serve as the starting point.

nextSteps.title: Clarification
nextSteps.text: Areas of uncertainty are clarified before settling on a solution.

nextSteps.title: Next step
nextSteps.text: A suitable next step can then be proposed, with no automatic response-time commitment.

faq.question: What kinds of projects do you take on?
faq.answer: The published offerings cover three delivery solutions — websites, targeted automations, and custom web applications — plus a cross-cutting audit and scoping service.

faq.question: Do you only work in Quebec?
faq.answer: Infotechs Solutions is based in Montérégie and serves small and medium businesses and organizations in Quebec. Any other scope is discussed based on context.

faq.question: When does it make sense to talk about automation?
faq.answer: When a repetitive task, double entry, or a manual transfer is slowing down a clearly identified process.

faq.question: Can we start with a small scope?
faq.answer: Yes. Scoping in particular helps isolate a first step that's useful, verifiable, and compatible with the known constraints.

page.finalTitle: Context, users, goals, and constraints: start with the useful facts.
page.finalText: The form sends this information to Infotechs Solutions for review, with no guaranteed response time or commercial outcome.
